description: The shipped contribution resolver in a generated crate: gen schema generates a committed self-contained schema whose resolution policy names the shipped layered resolver under selection=union with a merge=union notes field and a scope slot, twice into scratch trees the harness requires byte-identical; the generated crate compiles inside a scratch workspace materialized from this scenario's committed template beside a consumer crate that installs the resolver statically and depends on the generated crate alone, with no plugin loader. The exercise pins that loading without the resolver installed fails closed with the resolver-not-installed code, that the re-exported regex primitive matches a whole line under the schema's own pattern codec and fails closed on an uncompilable pattern, that the plain generated reader leaves contributions as records, that reader_with_contribution_resolver settles each (target, scope) partition under the declared layer precedence into resolution items whose values match as typed Setting structs through the generated crate's typed contribution projection (the merged notes list appended across layers, the scope slot decoded as its reference type, the option domain consumed through the generated DOMAIN constant), that the schema-form exhaustive marker lets the consumer match the generated Patch union with no wildcard arm and rebuild the generated Setting by a full struct literal, that the generated OptionName string newtype keys a HashMap looked up by a plain str and formats as its text, that the generated Item names each declaration through its one string identity field and a record as none, that an ordered map nested in an optional object field and one in a node-local record field compile and decode through the generated types, and that a record naming a target no record contributes fails the reading with the resolution-failed code and no resolution item; finally, the reading collected whole iterates its option declarations through the generated Choice type and looks each settled contribution up by target and scope on the reading surface, the two same-target contributions reporting one settled value and one the resolver never joined, and the scoped one its settled value under its scope
